title: Part Fourteen: The Poverty Trap and the Criminal-Legal Bill

sections.brief: Orshansky thresholds (1963-65; economy food plan x3; official 1969; CPI-indexed, never re-based); official 10.2% vs SPM 13.1% (2025) and what moves people across (Social Security 28.8m, tax credits 6.1m, medical costs +7.7m); 2026 guidelines vs $15,080 full-time minimum wage; ALICE 41% of households (2024 data); cost of being poor linked to Parts Nine and Eleven; Burkhauser et al. full-income 1.6% counter; where it works. Figures: time; stats; compare (told vs record for the part)

Incarceration 1980-2023 (3.6x count, 2.5x rate, -21% from 2008 peak; 25.5% pretrial); commercial bail; Illinois 2023; Bearden 1983; California AB 1869; FCC 2024 caps, June 2025 waiver, Oct 2025 higher caps in force 6 April 2026; commissary; prison labour and the 13th Amendment exception; Pager and Agan-Starr callbacks; Brennan lost earnings; child-support arrears; labelled interpretation with counter-readings. Figures: stats; money (bail and fines cycle); compare (phone caps); money (record's lifetime cost)

HUD PIT 2007-2025 (record 771,480 in 2024; 745,652 in Jan 2025, -3%; HUD's framing and the 1.46m figure); Colburn-Aldern rents vs addiction explanations; vacancy comparison corrected; Grants Pass 2024; July 2025 executive order; CoC notices, litigation and First Circuit stay (status Oct 2026); Housing First trials vs NASEM 2018 and HUD's critique. Figures: stats; time; compare
